title: Fix guest to customer transformation issue
issue_title: Can't access FO admin after account was transfered guest to customer by the merchant
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

### Describe the bug

After transforming the Guest account to a Customer through the back office, the customer's merchant can't access his account since the password is randomly generated and never transferred to him.

### Expected behavior

After transforming the Guest account to a Customer through the back office, the customer's merchant should be able to access his account.

### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Command a product with a Guest account
2. Go to Customer view page or Order view page (1.7.6)
3. Click on "Transform guest account to customer account"
- It sends an email with email and generates a random password
4. A customer receives an email with only his email and no password

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43613217/75791915-8f95d080-5d6d-11ea-995e-5d478eea44fb.png)

So the customer can't access his account, except by resetting his password.

**Why?** 
The old template used to send in the password but for security reasons, we have hidden it on the new template design.

### Solution

Add a link to reset the password (the same from password_query template) with a new wording.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43613217/75792573-72153680-5d6e-11ea-9b8e-74764b892a11.png)

title: Fix X-Forwarded-For not supported properly
issue_title: X-Forwarded-For not supported properly
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
Given an installation of PrestaShop behind a reverse proxy / load balancer, I am seeing the following issues:

- When a user comes to the front office, the client IP is incorrectly evaluated as the IP address of the proxy/load balancer, and it ignores the X-Forwarded-For headers. This makes the "Visitors online" screen incorrect. (and likely other things)

- Maintenance Mode also ignores X-Forwarded-For headers. You can enable the Maintenance Mode, but you will not be able to add a IP address that will be able to see the front office.  I am assuming it evaluates all client addresses as the load balancer / proxy IP address. So if you put in the load balancer IP address, you will be able to see the front office, but the public will be able to as well.

title: Don't loose group access on object model category save()

issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
Group access is lost when $category->save() is executed. Access group is always reinit to the 3 default groups.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to category admin page id_category X
2. Uncheck a group in group access or check and non default group (i.e. pro group).
3. Save this category in another place (controller or module code) with `$category = new Category(X; $category->save();`
4. See error : group access is lost and reinit to the 3 default groups.

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.2
PHP version: 7

The bug is probably linked to the Category::cleanGroups() method that is launched by $category->save()
It's may be the same bug as https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/11289

<!--

**Describe the bug**
During installation the `currency_lang` values are not correctly set.

**To Reproduce**
I already have two languages in my shop (French, English), and two currencies (Euro, Dollar). And I have customization on one of them (let's say Euro).
If I install a new Language the currency_lang for the new Language are correctly added in the database, but their value are incorrect. They don't match the default value of the new language (name, symbol and pattern are not correct). It seems the data from the default language are copied in the other languages instead of using the CLDR data.

![Capture d’écran 2019-12-04 à 16 33 26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13801017/70156181-d3683380-16b3-11ea-825f-11c96845e710.png)

If I go and edit the incorrect currency the symbol and pattern are a bit better (they still use the transformation used but at least they respect the language specification).

And if i use the 'Reset default settings' (on official currencies) the custom values are reset and the names are also correct.


**Solution**
All these behavior are logical from the form point of view, the issue is not on the form but on the Language installation. When a Language/Localization pack is installed the currency_lang should have correct values:
 - name: translated name of the currency (or ISO code for unofficial currency)

### Describe the bug Correct the default rewrite pattern to make it non greedy, so that others ids will be parsed wherever they are located in the route. A bug prevents to directly access with its direct URL a product combination that is not the default one. ### Steps to reproduce In the BO, in the SEO & URL page, in the field Product route enter "{manufacturer:/}{rewrite}{-:id_product_attribute}-{id}". Then in the FO go to the page of a product with a combination. **Describe the bug**
